rules.description: Minimum paid annual leave: 4 weeks = 20 working days (5-day week) or 24 working days (6-day week)

source.title: Cyprus Department of Labour Relations: Working Time / Minimum Paid Annual Holidays

versions.notes: Department of Labour Relations: "All employees are entitled to at least 4 weeks annual leave yearly", minimum 20 working days on a 5-day week, 24 on a 6-day week. Annual Holidays with Pay Law qualifying rules (48 weeks) and the Central Holiday Fund not modelled. Verified as the law in force on the verification date; historical effective date not researched, so effectiveFrom is set to 2026-01-01 (earlier dates resolve to the parent/none).
